canh.prompt: A slow push-in camera captures Hân Hân and Nhật Minh standing on a bustling ancient Hanoi street under warm amber streetlights. Hân Hân, dressed in an orange FPT polo shirt, holds an open Grade 9 History textbook, her head turning slightly as she speaks with natural lip movement and gestures gracefully toward the page. Nhật Minh stands beside her, nodding attentively with a gentle smile. Soft evening breeze gently rustles the nearby foliage, while distant city lights softly twinkle in the background.

A slow vertical push-in frames two 15-year-old students in orange polo shirts standing on an ancient street. Hân Hân speaks naturally to the camera with subtle head nods and natural lip movement. Beside her, Nhật Minh smiles and raises his hand in a welcoming gesture, inviting viewers to comment. In the soft-focus background, ancient yellow walls and hanging lanterns sway gently in a soft breeze, while dust motes drift slowly through warm sunlight.
